prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1322; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Pasadena, Texas?

A: Yes, that's right. I was driving my own car.

Q: Can you describe where you were and what you were doing just before the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road, waiting to turn. Traffic was moving slowly in the lane ahead, and I had my foot on the brake.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind, and my head snapped forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: Only in the mirror, a second or two before. It looked like it was coming up fast, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: After the impact, did you get out of the vehicle?

A: I got out briefly, but my neck and shoulder were hurting badly, so I sat back down. Someone nearby called for help.

Q: Can you describe the injury you're reporting?

A: My right shoulder is the main problem. It's sore when I raise my arm above my head, and I have a dull ache that runs down into my upper arm. I've been using a sling since the day after.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider for this?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon, and I've been referred to a specialist for follow-up.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been careful to follow the treatment plan, and I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the pain.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this recorded statement.
